name: Lifetime Contribution to Konkani Cinema Award
benefit:
**Cash Award:** ₹50,000/- as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
**Honorary Items:** Shawl, memento, and citation presented to the awardee.
**Recognition Ceremony:** Special function held on 24th April every year on the anniversary of the first Konkani film.
_*The awardee must be present in person to receive the award at the ceremony._
_*The award ceremony attendance is mandatory - no proxy or represen
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant must have contributed to Konkani Cinema development. **Relaxation** - The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artiste is not well. **Selection Considerations** - The applicant should demonstrate excellence as an actor, script writer, director, playback singer, lyricist, producer, or composer. - The applicant may have received awards in their respective field. - The applicant should have done innovation on the Konkani Cinema front. - The applicant, if a singer/musician, should have songs recorded on vinyl records, Compact Discs, Digital Versatile Discs, online platforms, or brought out in video format. - The applicant may have worked in films of other languages in various capacities including acting, directing, singing, composing music, composing lyrics, designing sets, providing background music, or designing light effects. - The applicant, if a script writer or lyricist, may have published books of their scripts or lyrics.
